title: svelte-realtime extension frames, revision 1
description: JSON Schema for the control frames the svelte-realtime layer adds on top of the Lantean protocol (svelte-adapter-uws/protocol.schema.json). The core protocol's frame-level forward-compatibility rule passes unrecognized application control frames through to the application handler; these are those frames for this package. A validator for mixed ecosystem traffic accepts a frame when it matches EITHER the core schema or this one. Additional properties are permitted everywhere: a peer ignores fields it does not recognize.

proto.description: Protocol-revision advertisement, client to server, sent once after connect when configure({ protocolVersion }) is set. A server running a NEWER revision answers with a 'protocol-stale' data event on the '__realtime' topic (once per connection); it never disconnects over a revision mismatch, and a client that never advertises is never signaled.

v.description: The client bundle's svelte-realtime protocol revision.
